abstract: Persistent Müllerian duct syndrome is a male hermaphroditism in which remnants of Müllerian ducts occur from abnormality of Müllerian inhibitory factor and often cause transverse testicular ectopia or hernia uteri inguinalis. A 22-year-old-man was admitted with the chief complaint of painless swelling of the right scrotal content. Preoperative diagnosis was right testicular tumor and left undescended testis. High orchiectomy was done. At operation left transverse testicular ectopia and a remnant Müllerian duct was found incidentally. The right testicular tumor was seminoma pT1. Sixty-seven cases of transverse testicular ectopia have been reported in Japan, 37 of which are reports of a remnant Müllerian duct. Ten of these cases were accompanied by tumors. The pathogenesis and treatment of persistent Müllerian duct syndrome were discussed with review of the literature.
abstract_ja: 持続性ミュラー管症候群は、ミュラー管抑制因子の異常によりミュラー管の遺残が生じる男性仮性半陰陽であり、しばしばtransverse testicular ectopiaや鼠径子宮ヘルニアを伴う。22歳男性が右陰嚢内容の無痛性腫脹を主訴に来院した。術前診断は右精巣腫瘍および左停留精巣であった。右高位精巣摘除術を施行した。手術時、左のtransverse testicular ectopiaとミュラー管遺残が偶発的に認められた。右精巣腫瘍はpT1のセミノーマであった。本邦ではtransverse testicular ectopiaの報告が67例あり、そのうち37例にミュラー管遺残を認め、10例は腫瘍を合併していた。持続性ミュラー管症候群の病態と治療について、文献的考察を加えて論じた。
